reviews.notes: Uses real process execution, scoped tests, and observed-payload/document comparison; historical byte-for-byte preservation is not invented.

Reconciliation and identity checks are strong, but output-record-fidelity makes the input schema and source-value-only fields mandatory although the task does not forbid a useful derived column or a different cleaned schema.

Mixed formulas/constants are made an instant reject and the worker is told to clear errors/placeholders anywhere in the workbook. Both are artifact heuristics broader than the task and can reject or expand correct work.
Reconciles clean/redline artifacts, protects exactly named terms, traces mandatory policy clauses, and limits coherence findings to concrete internal contradictions.
The glossary is required by the task, but the validator says missing glossary access is non-blocking. That can approve a required terminology claim without evidence.
The sampled task accidentally omitted the museum names and must be resampled. The design also treats an unreachable official page as non-blocking even though current official facts are required.

The visual checks are artifact-native, but they invent blocking physical-size and contrast thresholds and assume all non-kit colors are invalid. Those rules must come from the brief/brand kit or a demonstrated unreadable result.

The audio and timing oracles are correct, but the prompts say neither approve nor reject if the audio cannot be examined while the schema only supports approved true/false. Required evidence gaps need an unambiguous approved:false outcome.
Separates inventory/equipment feasibility, bench readiness, exact quantitative recomputation, and SOP safety without claiming the experiment ran.
If agenda/link source or attendee free/busy is unavailable, validators substitute generic non-placeholder content or partial availability and can approve the wrong event/slot.

The complete post-state query is strong, but exact time-boundary records and no-collateral-change evidence are made non-blocking when unavailable, so planted boundary and collateral defects can escape.
The exact computation and proof referee are strong, but the third arithmetic checker substantially duplicates defects already caught by full-set computation and proof review.

generalFailureClasses: Artifact heuristics and whole-artifact cleanliness were promoted into acceptance rules.
Missing required evidence was sometimes converted into a weaker proxy or a non-blocking check.
Relative-time and external-state claims lacked an operation-time evidence boundary.
The designer reflexively emitted 3-4 validators in exactly two stages.
The transform discarded structured ISSUE_OPENED content before generated agents ran.
